title: 第3章 仙路漫漫诸位慢行第4章 私生饭真可怕
lines: “天上白玉京，十二楼五城。
仙人抚我顶，结发受长生……”
酒到七分，白羽忍不住兽性…呸，忍不住诗兴大发。
他站在护栏上诗朗诵，一首接一首。
隐忍二十年，今日他也要出一出风头！
秘技，唐诗三百首！
初时，路人与朋友只当他发酒疯，可听着听着就觉得不对了。
这这这……
诗仙在世呀！
李白：我有话讲！
他不用讲，白羽全替他讲了。
这坊市里鱼龙混杂，有修仙者有武者，也有普通人。
他们喝酒挑的地儿是一般凡人武者聚集地，不然白羽还真不敢这么装。
万一碰上一个认为白羽比他优秀就要除之而后快的，那真是摊上事了。
嫉妒心上头，在坊市里他不动手，万一明天跟着白羽出去非要除之而后快呢？
这里本就很多不得志的修仙者，试探不得。
所以说，跟凡人们装一装就好了。
种了二十年地，我还不能装一装了？
他诗性大发之际，这条街汇聚了越来越多的人。
大家就站在街上听他背诗，没人敢打扰他，生怕错过佳作。
不懂鉴赏？
不会的，能在这里混，那都是有文化的人。
“人生得意须尽欢，莫使金樽空对月。
天生我材必有用，千金散尽还复来……”
与此同时。
坊市中央，一座安静的院子里。
一间屋子窗户被推开，一妙龄少女望月叹息。
没有复杂的装束，也没有精致的妆容，但就看她一眼就觉得此女只应天上有。
五官绝对是女娲造人时造出来的精品，精雕玉琢。
望着一轮明月，她幽幽道：
“众里寻她千百度，蓦然回首，那人却在，灯火阑珊处……”
满脸陶醉，她掏出一本书呢喃道：“浪里小白龙，他到底经历过什么，才能写出如此多的好诗，句句写在我的心坎上。”
content_en:
“The white jade capital in the sky has five cities on the twelfth floor.
Immortals caress my head, knot my hair and receive immortality..."
When the wine reached 70%, Bai Yu couldn't help his animalistic nature... Bah, he couldn't help but become poetic.
He stood on the guardrail and recited poems, one after another.
After being patient for twenty years, he wants to show off today!
Secret technique, three hundred Tang poems!
At first, passers-by and friends just thought he was drunk and crazy, but after listening to it, they felt something was wrong.
This, this, this...
Shixian is alive!
Li Bai: I have something to say!
He didn't need to talk, Bai Yu did it all for him.
There is a mixed crowd in this city, including immortal cultivators, warriors, and ordinary people.
The place they chose to drink was a gathering place for ordinary mortal warriors, otherwise Bai Yu would not dare to pretend like this.
If you meet someone who thinks Bai Yu is better than him and wants to get rid of him quickly, you will really get into trouble.
He was so jealous that he didn't take action in the market. What if he followed Bai Yu out tomorrow and had to get rid of him quickly?
There are already many unsuccessful immortal cultivators here, and they cannot be tested.
So, just pretend to be like ordinary people.
After twenty years of farming, I still can’t pretend?
When his poetry flourished, more and more people gathered on this street.
Everyone stood on the street and listened to him reciting poems. No one dared to disturb him for fear of missing a masterpiece.
Don’t know how to appreciate it?
No, those who can hang out here are literate people.
“If you are happy in life, you must have all the joy, and don’t let the golden cup stand empty against the moon.
It is my nature that my talents will be useful, and I will come back after all the money I have spent is gone..."
At the same time.
In the middle of the city, in a quiet courtyard.
"Creak~!"
The window of a room was pushed open, and a young girl looked at the moon and sighed.
There was no complicated outfit or exquisite makeup, but just by looking at her, I felt that this woman should only exist in heaven.
The facial features are absolutely exquisite and exquisitely crafted when Nuwa created humans.
Looking at the bright moon, she said quietly:
"The crowd searched for her a thousand times, but suddenly I looked back, and there she was, in a dimly lit place..."
With her face filled with intoxication, she took out a book and murmured: "Little White Dragon in the Langli, what on earth has he gone through to be able to write so many good poems? Every sentence is written in my heart."
title_en: Chapter 3: The road to immortality is long, everyone, go slowly Chapter 4: Illegitimate meal is really scary
